canonicalArrivalAccessPoint: Represented city-hub record itself; no child POI endpoint is represented
accessPatternResearched: Repository city-hubs.json and cityHubs.ts define this parentless kind=city, role=hub record as the planning/arrival hub; no destination-local leg is represented.

closureOrSuspension.detail: City-hub N/A decision is not based on closure or fare availability.

reason: The explicit city-hub contract represents the arrival/planning hub itself and has no child-specific destination-local access obligation.

semanticReview.canonicalArrival: The represented city-hub record itself is the canonical arrival scope; no station name is substituted.
semanticReview.coverageDecision: not_applicable for the represented hub scope.
semanticReview.fareProduct: Not applicable; no fare is being asserted.
semanticReview.multipleRequiredSegments: None represented for the hub record.
semanticReview.noDoubleCounting: Prevents adding a citywide/local sightseeing leg to a child destination or charging the hub record twice.
semanticReview.originTravelCoverage: The record is the repository planning/arrival hub; origin_travel terminates at the represented hub scope rather than a child POI.
semanticReview.paidAccessAssessment: No destination-local transport product is part of the hub record; admission and optional onward travel are separate.
semanticReview.requiredLocalLegs: None for the hub record itself; child attractions are separate records and must carry their own localTransport facts.
semanticReview.walkingAssessment: Not evaluated as a station-to-POI walk because this record is not an individual POI.

whyBoundedDefensibleAccessIsInappropriat: Not selected without a source-backed defensible distance/fare band and explicit coverage; no estimate is inferred from coordinates.
whyNotApplicableIsInappropriate: Not selected unless the destination record itself is an explicit hub with no child-specific local leg; city-hub N/A is limited to city-hubs.json.
whySegmentOnlyIsInsufficient: A segment-only fare cannot complete the local-transport component; it is not used unless the remaining required segments are explicitly represented elsewhere.
whyVerifiedRequiredAccessIsInappropriate: Not selected unless required local segments, ordinary-adult product/fare, and destination endpoint are all source-backed; the current decision is not_applicable.
whyVerifiedWalkingIsInappropriate: Not selected unless the exact canonical arrival-to-destination walking relationship is authoritative; the current decision is not_applicable.

accessPatternResearched: Canonical repository arrival Tokyo Station was checked against the destination-specific official/operator access material; retrieved source paths=1; failures remain separate.

closureOrSuspension.detail: No closure or suspension was used as a basis for this residual decision in the retained checks.

fact.detail: Canonical arrival Tokyo Station is established, but destination-specific required local access and current ordinary-adult fare could not be represented from the reviewed source set. Retrieval failures are listed separately and are not treated as evidence.

reason: Canonical arrival is Tokyo Station; 1 authoritative/operator source path(s) were retrieved and reviewed for destination-specific access. The remaining fact is not representable as a verified fare without a current saleable route/product; no value is fabricated.

semanticReview.originTravelCoverage: Origin-travel coverage was evaluated against Tokyo Station; no unrecorded hub or destination parent was substituted.
semanticReview.paidAccessAssessment: Paid access was retained only when a current saleable route/product and exact coverage were established; otherwise it remains unresolved.
semanticReview.requiredLocalLegs: The official access topology and any required final segments were reviewed; unresolved segments are not silently omitted.

semanticReview.requiredLocalLegs: The official access topology and any required final segments were reviewed; unresolved segments are not silently omitted.

、豊かな生命力・活力を授けて戴く吉方位に鎮座。
市杵嶋姫命(弁財天)の御神像は、八の肘の八臂で手にはそれぞれ弓・刀・斧・羅索・矢・杵・矛・宝珠を持っており、財運・厄除け・知恵・音楽・諸芸・交通航海・産業振興・五穀豊饒・富貴の守護神として、また御神像の頭上には、鳥居と男神を頂く事から夫婦円満・縁結び・子授け・安産の神様として信仰を集めている。

canonicalArrivalAccessPoint: Shizuoka Station
accessPatternResearched: Canonical repository arrival Shizuoka Station was checked against the destination-specific official/operator access material; retrieved source paths=1; failures remain separate.

closureOrSuspension.detail: No closure or suspension was used as a basis for this residual decision in the retained checks.

fact.detail: Canonical arrival Shizuoka Station is established, but destination-specific required local access and current ordinary-adult fare could not be represented from the reviewed source set. Retrieval failures are listed separately and are not treated as evidence.

reason: Canonical arrival is Shizuoka Station; 1 authoritative/operator source path(s) were retrieved and reviewed for destination-specific access. The remaining fact is not representable as a verified fare without a current saleable route/product; no value is fabricated.

semanticReview.canonicalArrival: Shizuoka Station
semanticReview.coverageDecision: No numeric coverage is asserted for an unresolved fact; topology-blocked cases remain unavailable only because the physical origin context is absent.
semanticReview.fareProduct: No fare/product is fabricated; any fare gap is explicitly separated from retrieval failures.
semanticReview.multipleRequiredSegments: Multiple required segments were considered; no through-fare or segment coverage is assumed without source evidence.
semanticReview.noDoubleCounting: Origin-travel legs, destination-local legs, optional admission, and alternative routes remain separate; no parent ID is used as an arrival point.
semanticReview.originTravelCoverage: Origin-travel coverage was evaluated against Shizuoka Station; no unrecorded hub or destination parent was substituted.
semanticReview.paidAccessAssessment: Paid access was retained only when a current saleable route/product and exact coverage were established; otherwise it remains unresolved.
semanticReview.requiredLocalLegs: The official access topology and any required final segments were reviewed; unresolved segments are not silently omitted.
semanticReview.walkingAssessment: A verified walking fact was not selected unless an authoritative source tied the exact physical arrival to a practical walk.

whyBoundedDefensibleAccessIsInappropriat: Not selected without a source-backed defensible distance/fare band and explicit coverage; no estimate is inferred from coordinates.
whyNotApplicableIsInappropriate: Not selected unless the destination record itself is an explicit hub with no child-specific local leg; city-hub N/A is limited to city-hubs.json.
whySegmentOnlyIsInsufficient: A segment-only fare cannot complete the local-transport component; it is not used unless the remaining required segments are explicitly represented elsewhere.
whyVerifiedRequiredAccessIsInappropriate: Not selected unless required local segments, ordinary-adult product/fare, and destination endpoint are all source-backed; the current decision is unavailable.
whyVerifiedWalkingIsInappropriate: Not selected unless the exact canonical arrival-to-destination walking relationship is authoritative; the current decision is unavailable.
